recognize_zh: 低倍胃切片中，表層仍保有胃腺體，但其下方的深部黏膜與黏膜下層被一條厚而致密的深藍色淋巴細胞帶佔滿，腺體被推擠變少，浸潤直達黏膜下脂肪上方，是胃 MALT 淋巴瘤的低倍表現。
features: Thick band-like dense basophilic lymphoid infiltrate expanding deep mucosa and submucosa
Superficial gastric glands preserved but separated and reduced in number, with focal gland loss
Infiltrate abuts submucosal fat and vessels at the base
Surface epithelium largely intact; no deep ulceration in this field
Lymphoepithelial lesions and cytology not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of gastric wall shows a dense, band-like lymphoid infiltrate expanding the deep lamina propria and submucosa beneath the preserved superficial glandular mucosa. The infiltrate separates and partially replaces the gastric glands and extends down to the submucosal fat. Lymphoepithelial lesions and cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of gastric extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT, requiring higher-power evaluation and immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD43, cytokeratin for lymphoepithelial lesions, light chains).

ddx.dx: Chronic H. pylori gastritis with lymphoid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are superficial and mixed with discrete follicles and plasma cells, lack destructive lymphoepithelial lesions and are polyclonal.
DLBCL shows sheets of large transformed B cells with high Ki-67 rather than small marginal zone cells.
MCL is composed of monotonous small cells expressing CD5 and cyclin D1.
